title: A Recipe for the Homecoming
author: Oscar Kavanagh
blurb: Ines Okonkwo, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
